print_danish_time = function() {
  time = lubridate::with_tz(Sys.time(), "CET")
  
  paste0( strftime(time,tz="CET",format="%A %b")," ",scales::ordinal_format()(lubridate::day(time))," ",strftime(time,tz="CET",format="%Y %H:%M")," ",lubridate::tz(time))
}

This report was compiled `r print_danish_time() `.

This is a quick route into my market and macro research. The charts use public data from [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/), [Statistics Denmark](https://www.dst.dk/), and [Finans Danmark](https://finansdanmark.dk/). Series refresh when the book is built; a provider may publish observations later than the build date, and market prices may be carried forward over non-trading days.

## Start here

- [Market snapshots](equity-markets-and-the-sp-500.html): six markets at a glance, with links to detailed indicator charts.
- [Interest rates and yield curves](interest-rates-and-yield-curves.html): US and Danish rates, spreads, and model diagnostics.
- [Leading economic indicators](leading-economic-indicators.html): macro series and their correlations.
- [US housing](united-states-housing-market.html) and [Danish housing](danish-housing-market.html): construction and price trends.
- [ETF analysis](etf-tracking-and-analysis.html): historical rankings and correlations.
- [Danish fund taxation](etf-tracking-and-analysis.html#danish-fund-tax): 2026 ETF and investment-fund classifications for an ordinary depot and aktiesparekonto.

The [economic release calendar](economic-release-calendar.html) is the quickest way to check which series may have updated recently.
